caption:
Need €24,789 a year to go nomad in Europe? That's Italy, the lowest bar of the three.

Digital nomad visa income, per year:
Italy: €24,789
Spain: €34,188
Portugal: €44,160

Each government sets its own threshold and updates it over time. Check the latest figure with your consulate before you apply.

Save this before you pick a country. Spain DNV document kit: link in bio.

alt_text: Cover: Spain non-lucrative visa, every document. Swipe, save, tick them off.
Forms and ID: national visa application form, signed form EX-01, passport valid one year or more with two free pages, one recent passport photo.
Proof of means: 2,400 euros a month, 400 percent of IPREM, plus 600 euros a month per family member, shown for 12 months or as regular income.
Health and background: Spain-authorised health insurance, criminal record covering the last five years, medical certificate.
Admin: proof of address in the consular district, form 790 code 052 fee paid, apostille and Spanish translation.
The detail that trips people up: the criminal record and medical certificate are valid for 6 months, so order them last.
Spain Non-Lucrative Visa Kit, 49 euros: dossier index with means calculation, letter of intent in Spanish and English, sworn statement of non-activity. Link in bio.
caption:
Spain non-lucrative visa: the full document list in one place. Save it and tick them off.

The number that matters: €2,400 a month (400% of IPREM) for you, plus €600 for each family member.

The trap: your criminal record and medical certificate are only valid for 6 months, so order them last.

Send this to whoever is planning the move with you. Spain NLV kit with letter of intent and means calculation: link in bio.

caption:
Portugal D2 visa: plan on €11,040 in savings. That's 12 months of Portugal's €920 minimum wage.

The D2 is for freelancers and founders starting a business in Portugal, and the business plan carries the application.

Save this if Portugal is on your list. D2 business plan template: link in bio.
